crossRefs.note: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
He said to him, “Don’t be afraid; for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and…
Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.
You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of…
I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every…
so that he who blesses himself in the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears in the earth will…
those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,
For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be…
For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest…

translations.web: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
translations.bsb: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
translations.kjv: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
translations.asv: But the king shall rejoice in God: Every one that sweareth by him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped. Psalm 64 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
